title: Sandboxed-skill verification harness ships as framework default by Q3 2026
body: By Q3 2026 the open-source sandboxed-skill verification harness that Anthropic's Claude Code 3.0 Mythos-Preview registry has been running at scale ships as an upstream framework default across the LangChain plus AutoGen plus CrewAI plus Haystack plus Pydantic AI maintainer cohort, exposing the deterministic per-tenant attestation-log audit trail and cross-tenant compositional safety check as a standard framework-side primitive rather than a vendor-private surface. The Wednesday catalysts trace a clean readout that the harness now scales across the full five-paper loader-verification reference set and across seventy gated tenants without timing slip. A Wednesday Anthropic operations note reports Claude Code 3.0 day-thirteen registry telemetry counting roughly 34,400 published skills (up from Tuesday's 32,800, +4.9 percent — a seventh consecutive sub-7-percent reading and the first sub-5-percent day of the second week), approximately 2.96M skill installs across the thirteenth 24 hours, and seventy Mythos-Preview gated tenants — two business days ahead of the cohort's projected window — with two new Continental European public-sector signings on top of Tuesday's Indo-Pacific additions. A Wednesday Simon Willison note documents that the harness's deterministic per-tenant attestation-log audit trail reproduces across all seventy gated tenants with cross-tenant compositional safety checks holding under 55 seconds, and the harness now includes Tuesday's tenant-policy-attestation manifest verification step alongside Monday's training-surface checkpoint-provenance step and the standard cross-tenant audit — confirming the Verifiable Per-Tenant Capability Attestation paper's demonstration cycle scales cleanly as the loader-verification line composes its full surface. Wednesday's arxiv 2605.07891 consolidation survey gives the harness a single citable end-to-end verification graph spanning training-run checkpoint through agent-loader through tenant-policy gate, and a Wednesday DeepMind note confirms the consolidated Python-and-Rust reference-implementation index now indexes the tenant-policy-attestation manifest alongside the training-surface harness — leaving the harness with a fully unified reference-implementation surface to upstream. The framework maintainer cohort's Wednesday Hugging Face Blog post holds the mid-June default-shipment commitment with the tenant-policy-attestation manifest folded in as an optional sixth verification surface, and the Wednesday InfoQ note reports the six-vendor cross-orchestrator interop matrix conformance test suite holding green across all six vendors for a third consecutive weekday with the same manifest check running on every conformance pass — giving framework maintainers a vendor-side conformance signal they can lean on when promoting the harness from optional to default. The structural force is that once the harness reproduces deterministically across seventy gated tenants holding under 55 seconds, the five-paper reference set unifies into one verification graph with one reference-implementation index, and the framework cohort already ships the sixth surface as optional inside mid-June with a six-vendor conformance suite green for three weekdays, the optional-to-default promotion compresses to a release-cycle decision rather than an unsolved engineering question — and the mid-June default-shipment ships the full harness as a Q3 2026 followup release. The most likely landing is the open-source harness shipping as a framework default across the maintainer cohort inside Q3 2026, with the Anthropic Mythos-Preview registry continuing to operate the canonical reference deployment, the consolidated DeepMind plus Meta AI plus Anthropic plus Microsoft reference-implementation index serving as the upstream source-of-truth, and the cross-orchestrator interop matrix's conformance test suite serving as the cross-vendor regression gate. Bear case is that the framework cohort defers the optional-to-default flip to a follow-up minor release inside Q4 2026 if any of the five-paper surface composition checks logs a regression during the mid-June default-shipment dry-run; absent that, Q3 2026 lands the harness as framework default.

reasoning.because: Anthropic harness reproduces across 70 gated tenants under 55s with tenant-policy step layered.
reasoning.given: Framework cohort mid-June ships sixth surface optional; arxiv 2605.07891 unifies the graph.
reasoning.so_that: The open-source verification harness flips from optional vendor-side surface to framework-default upstream primitive.
reasoning.landing: By Q3 2026; LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Haystack, Pydantic AI default it.
reasoning.plain_language: The safety checker that proves an AI tool is genuine will soon be built into the main AI building blocks, not just one vendor's product.

summary: Wednesday's Anthropic note reports Claude Code 3.0 reaching 70 Mythos-Preview gated tenants with the verification harness reproducing under 55 seconds and the tenant-policy step layered, and arxiv 2605.07891 unifies the five-paper reference set. By Q3 2026 the harness ships as framework default.
